## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: very narrow sector breadth (only Technology and Healthcare positive) and large-cap weakness in Financials and Communication (multiple leaders BELOW TREND), while leadership is concentrated across just 3 sectors; leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Healthcare leads: TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +5.83% | 1M: +0.15%) ABOVE TREND; Technology also positive with AAPL (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +6.09%) ABOVE TREND and NVDA (1W: +1.82% | 1M: +2.28%) ABOVE TREND. Sector breadth context: Healthcare and Technology are the only positive sectors today.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Communication worst: NFLX (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -10.51%) BELOW TREND, TMUS (1W: -7.76% | 1M: -7.24%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -12.07% | 1M: -15.94%) BELOW TREND. Financials weak: BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -8.47% | 1M: -7.34%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: PANW (1W: +9.96% | 1M: +1.06%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND, TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND, ISRG (1W: +6.55% | 1M: -1.10%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5), flagging selective strength rather than broad market participation.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: BA (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -10.80%) BELOW TREND, CVS (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -10.51%) BELOW TREND, TMUS (1W: -7.76% | 1M: -7.24%) BELOW TREND, BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Communication and Financials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: PANW (1W: +9.96% | 1M: +1.06%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND; watch ISRG (1W: +6.55% | 1M: -1.10%) RECOVERY as a divergence (1W up vs 1M down) and LLY (1W: +3.34% | 1M: -9.95%) RECOVERY for tactical moves.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but net positive; AAPL (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +6.09%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +1.82% | 1M: +2.28%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +3.26% | 1M: +1.46%) ABOVE TREND while MSFT (1W: -0.37% | 1M: +2.15%) is in CORRECTION. Sector breadth: Technology is one of only two positive sectors today, so upside is narrow.

8. Financials Outlook?
Weak and under pressure; JPM (1W: -1.84% | 1M: -2.12%) BELOW TREND, BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -8.47% | 1M: -7.34%) BELOW TREND — sector momentum is negative and confirms part of the CAUTION regime.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Relatively constructive but mixed; TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +5.83% | 1M: +0.15%) ABOVE TREND, ISRG (1W: +6.55% | 1M: -1.10%) RECOVERY and LLY (1W: +3.34% | 1M: -9.95%) RECOVERY show short-term rotations into select names.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective Healthcare and resilient large-cap Tech (e.g., TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +6.09%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to Communication and Financials showing broad weakness; Style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow breadth and concentrated top performers.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: ISRG (1W: +6.55% | 1M: -1.10%) RECOVERY on EU approval and momentum, MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND on upgrades, AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NFLX (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -10.51%) BELOW TREND despite recent buyback headline (divergence), BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND on negative sentiment.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Healthcare (sector positive, selective names showing strength) and Technology (narrow positive leadership). BEARISH: Communication and Financials (broad weakness and negative sentiment).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA (1W: +1.82% | 1M: +2.28%) ABOVE TREND — hold above short-term support to confirm continuation; AAPL (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +6.09%) ABOVE TREND — maintain above monthly trend for sector leadership; BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND — further downside risks if momentum persists.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
ISRG (+75): ISRG (1W: +6.55% | 1M: -1.10%) RECOVERY — EU approval headline confirming price action. GOOGL (+60): GOOGL (1W: +3.26% | 1M: +1.46%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment and price confirming. MPC (+60): MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND — analyst upgrades confirming momentum. TMO (+50): TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND — news confirmed by strong performance.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
BAC (-65): BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND — negative sentiment confirmed by price weakness. NFLX (-55): NFLX (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -10.51%) BELOW TREND — negative analyst notes match distribution despite a separate buyback headline (divergence). CVS (-50/+50 mixed): CVS (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND — mixed headlines (bullish business review vs unit bankruptcy) create ambiguity; monitor for follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, style mixed / no clear leadership given very narrow breadth (2/11) and concentrated top performers. TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND and AAPL (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +6.09%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: low breadth and bullish headlines on NFLX (+80) are diverging from price (NFLX (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -10.51%) BELOW TREND) — watch for confirmation.
